findings.quote: A head that gives back nothing an hour after the wind drops is worth recording, though whether the tray has been obstructed by mortar dropped during the build, or is spilling into the cavity past a missing stop end, an open joint cannot say.
findings.note: Genre & source-plausibility: the implied reader is a practising surveyor deciding what to record on an inspection, not the general educated reader the short-ELF exemplars address. host-ver2-2019-verb1-ELF-031 opens 'Education is key to increased economic equality' and var-2022-1-verb1-ELF-031 opens 'Aging research may be on the rise, but it does have its own set of unique limitations' - both orient a lay reader in sentence one and use no unglossed trade vocabulary. This text opens cold inside the trade ('Above a window head') and stacks window head / cavity / tray / stop end / outer skin unglossed. Sits at the edge of the exemplar genre range rather than outside it; adjudication decides.
